use fx::double;

#[test] fn one_line() { assert_eq!(double(1), 2); }

#[rstest]
fn rs_test() {
    assert!(double(2) == 4);
}

#[test_case(3)]
fn case(x: i32) {
    debug_assert_eq!(double(x), 6);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn tokio_form() {
    assert_ne!(double(0), 1);
}

#[sqlx::test]
async fn sqlx_form() {
    let _ = double(0).checked_div(0).ok_or(()).unwrap_err();
}

#[test] // a comment after the attribute
fn commented() {
    // assert!(double(1) == 2);
    let text = "assert_eq!(1, 1)";
    my_assert!(text.is_empty());
}
#[test]
#[should_panic]
fn panics() {
    double(i32::MAX);
}

mod inner {
    #[test]
    fn nested() {
        let open = "}";
        assert!(!open.is_empty());
    }
}
